file_header:
==================================================
NL single-family house
CityGML 2.0 test dataset with Energy ADE 3.0 (beta 8)
==================================================

This dataset models a real single-family house in the
Netherlands, encoded in CityGML 2.0 with the Energy ADE
3.0 (beta 8). For privacy reasons the building has been
anonymised and its location shifted. All feature-level
energy attributes and metadata are populated.

Last update: 2026-06-10

Provenance
==================================================
Generated by Daan Schlosser for his MSc thesis in
Geomatics at the 3D Geoinformation group, Delft
University of Technology, the Netherlands, under the
RenoDAT research project (TU Delft / NWO, 2025 to 2029).

Dataset (4TU.ResearchData): https://doi.org/10.4121/89f8909b-4473-4958-8f93-46b55546764d

Viewing
==================================================
To visualise the data and explore the attributes you can
use the freeware KITModelViewer:
https://www.iai.kit.edu/1302.php

city_model.description: NL single-family house: an owner-occupied single-family residence in Delft used as the per-building test case for the CityGML 2.0 + EnergyADE 3.0 data model under the RenoDAT research project (TU Delft / NWO, 2025-2029). All feature-level energy attributes and metadata are populated.
city_model.name: NL single-family house

metadata.author: Daan Schlosser
metadata.quality_description: Building-level bdgArea carries the measured gross floor area only; BAG registers no Pand-level area. The register-vs-model usable-area comparison lives on the BuildingUnit, where the BAG oppervlakte (a verblijfsobject attribute under NEN 2580) belongs.

qualified_area.description: Gross floor area derived from the on-site 3D measurement model (outer-wall envelope, including internal walls). The only Building-level area: BAG registers no Pand-level area.

qualified_height.description: Building height measured from ground-floor level to the top of the roof.

qualified_volume.description: Building's gross volume derived from the 3D model.

features.description: Sole verblijfsobject (VBO) inside the owner-occupier Pand. NL EP-online certificates are issued per-VBO, and the net floor area, occupants, and energy-performance certificate live at this unit-level rather than on the parent Building, so the structure is self-similar between the per-building and city-scale pipelines. The address itself is owned by the parent Building (CityGML 2.0 composition slot `bldg:address`) and referenced from here via an xlink (Energy ADE 3.0 UML tags `BuildingUnit.address` as `relationType=association`, i.e. a pointer).
name: Han Solo's House

metadata.quality_description: Usable (net) floor area disagrees between the BAG register (122.0 m2) and the measured 3D model (104.2 m2); both values are retained as separate QualifiedArea entries so downstream tooling can pick the provenance it trusts.

qualified_area.description: Usable floor area (gebruiksoppervlakte) as registered in the Dutch BAG (Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen); typed netFloorArea, the closest AreaTypeValue entry to the Dutch usable-area definition. A verblijfsobject attribute, so it lives on the BuildingUnit.
Net (usable) floor area from the on-site 3D measurement model (inside-face of outer walls, minus internal walls).

features.description: EP-online energy-performance certificate for the VBO. Authored from the EP-online register entry; the registration ID is anonymised (the real ID is held by the owner) but the codeSpace remains `https://www.ep-online.nl/` so a downstream consumer can recognise the source register. Method `Detailopname / NTA 8800:2024 (woningbouw)` and the kWh/(m²·yr) BerekendeEnergieverbruik value identify this as an NTA 8800-regime cert; status `actual` reflects that EP-online registered labels are *rechtsgeldig* per RVO's Handleiding EP-online.
name: EP-online energy label
features.label: A+

features.description: Whole-house final-electricity consumption from smart-meter import readings, monthly aggregates Jan 2022 – Jun 2025 (42 months). Recorded at BuildingUnit (VBO) scope because the smart meter is per-VBO and no per-end-use breakdown was collected; `end_use=otherOrCombination` is the codelist-honest pick for mixed end-uses on a single carrier. Includes everything the meter sees (heat-pump, EV charging, appliances, lighting). The PV self-consumption is *not* netted out — these are gross household consumption figures.
name: House electricity consumption

features.description: Monthly whole-house electricity consumption for id_building_unit_1, derived from smart-meter import readings (P1-port import totals). Covers Jan 2022 – Jun 2025 (42 months); cadence and date range mirror the PV production series so the two can be paired month-by-month for net-energy analyses.
name: MonthlyTimeSeries house consumption

features.description: 36 × 270 Wp polycrystalline / monocrystalline silicon module array (cellType not on the panel datasheet collected from the owner-occupier, recorded as `unknown`). The `nominal_efficiency` (0.164 W/W) is the module-area-based efficiency consistent with 9720 W / 59.4 m² at 1000 W/m² STC; the `aperture_area` (55.8 m²) is the active light-receiving cell area, conventionally ≈ 94% of the module footprint for crystalline-silicon panels of this generation. Both values are typical-product estimates from the panel rating, not measured datasheet figures.
name: PV collector (36x270 Wp)

features.description: NIBE F1255 PC ground-source heat pump on a vertical ground collector (bodemwarmte). Source 24 °C / system 31 °C. Pipework is insulated. The unit sits inside the thermal envelope; EnergyADE 3.0 has no native attribute for in-envelope vs outside-envelope placement, so this is recorded here in the description. The COP value (5.5) is a representative mid-range figure estimated from NIBE F1255 PC datasheet performance curves (manufacturer typical: COP ≈ 4.7 at 0°C source / 35°C heating, COP ≈ 6.5 at 10°C source / 35°C heating); the 24°C source / 31°C operation pair recorded here implies an unusually small temperature lift and would in principle yield a higher COP, but no per-installation measurement was collected so a conservative middle of the typical range is used.
name: NIBE F1255 PC

features.description: Hydronic distribution circuit fed by heat_pump_1 (low-temperature floor heating). Pipework is insulated. Return temperature was not collected.
name: Hydronic heat distribution

features.description: 200 L domestic-hot-water buffer, water-filled, installed inside the thermal envelope. EnergyADE 3.0 has no native attribute for in-envelope vs outside-envelope placement, so this is recorded here in the description. The `preparation_temperature` (32 °C) is read from the owner-occupier's thermal-storage stratification diagram (charged-state hot-side temperature), close to the heat pump's 31 °C operation temperature — i.e. this is a low-temperature buffer driven by the heat pump rather than a 60 °C+ DHW tank with separate legionella protection.
name: DHW buffer 200 L

features.description: Residents of Han Solo's house. Parented to the BuildingUnit (not the Building) because in the EnergyADE 3.0 model `occupiedBy` is inherited from `AbstractBuildingSpace`, so it lives on whichever space-level unit actually houses the residents. For a single-VBO Pand that is the BuildingUnit; in a multi-unit Pand each apartment can carry its own Occupants record. Only `numberOfOccupants` is recorded; per-occupant heat-dissipation, cohort-statistical attributes (diet / income / instruction level), and the occupancy schedule were deliberately not collected from the owner-occupier survey.
name: Occupants 1

features.description: EVHUB AC Mode 3 laadpaal, 3.7-22 kW (32A, 1/3-phase), Type 2 connector with 8m cable. IP55, polycarbonate housing (410x280x150 mm), built-in DC detection. Dedicated to Golf GTE 2015 (8.7 kWh gross / 7.5 kWh net); car-side limit 3.6 kW. ~150 charges/year.
name: EVHUB Laadpaal Type 2

features.description: Annual electricity consumption for EV charging (Golf GTE 2015, ~150 charges/year x 7.5 kWh net)
name: EV charging energy demand

features.description: PV energy production for pv_panel_1
name: PV Production pv_panel_1

features.description: Built-in keramische kookplaat (electric ceramic cooktop). EnergyADE 3.0 has no dedicated cooktop class; modelled as a GenericElectricalDevice for completeness. Energy consumption details not collected.
name: Ceramic electric cooktop

features.description: Magnetron-oven (microwave oven), kitchen-installed. Modelled as a GenericElectricalDevice for completeness. Energy consumption details not collected.
name: Microwave oven

features.description: Cooker (boiling-water) tap (Quooker-style). EnergyADE 3.0 has no boiling-tap class; modelled as a GenericElectricalDevice for completeness. Energy consumption details not collected.
name: Boiling-water tap

features.description: Koffiezetapparaat (coffee machine). Modelled as a GenericElectricalDevice for completeness. Energy consumption details not collected.
name: Coffee machine

features.description: Afwasmachine (dishwasher). Modelled as a GenericElectricalDevice for completeness. Energy consumption details not collected.
name: Dishwasher

features.description: Residential thermal zone with three storeys
name: Building zone

features.description: Ground floor, set to 22 °C heating / 24 °C cooling year-round, mechanically ventilated. The 22 °C setpoint is the year-round target; in practice the heat pump only fires in winter (when outdoor temperatures push the slab below the setpoint) and the cooling circuit only fires on hot summer days.
name: Ground floor

features.description: First floor, heated to 18 °C year-round, mechanically ventilated. The first floor receives most of its heat passively from the heated ground floor below; the upstairs heating circuit only triggers when the slab-mediated warmth is insufficient. The 18 °C setpoint is therefore a floor (a minimum-comfort guarantee), not the operating set-temperature.
name: First floor

features.description: Monthly PV energy production for pv_panel_1, derived from smart-meter export readings (P1-port export totals minus self-consumption-correction inferred against the inverter logger). Covers Jan 2022 – Jun 2025 (42 months).
name: MonthlyTimeSeries pv_panel_1

features.description: Simulated monthly PV production for pv_panel_1, an independent estimate to compare against the measured series id_pv_production_1. Computed with the NTA 8800:2024 method (clause 16.2) from the array peak power, inclination and azimuth against the NEN 5060 reference-climate irradiation, not from the module area.
name: Simulated PV production pv_panel_1 (NTA 8800)

metadata.author: Daan Schlosser
metadata.source: NTA 8800:2024 clause 16.2 monthly PV yield, NEN 5060 reference climate.
metadata.quality_description: Computed by tools/generate_pv_simulation.py, not metered. NTA 8800 monthly PV production with yield factor f_perf 0.80 (air gap behind the panels) and practical-performance factor f_prac 0.95.

features.description: Monthly simulated PV production, one value per month from 2022-01-01 up to (not including) 2026-01-01, so 48 monthly kWh totals running past the measured window. Each month carries its NTA 8800 production for the fixed NEN 5060 reference climate, so a given calendar month repeats across years.
name: MonthlyTimeSeries simulated PV production pv_panel_1
Material Library
features.description: Materials authored from the architectural specification of the owner-occupier residence (HSB timber-frame, with reed-thatched and PV-paneled roof sections). Thermal property values are the manufacturer's datasheet figures where the spec names the product (Knauf Naturoll 032 / 035, Fermacell, spaanplaat PRIME / V313, OSB3 grade, Morgo membranes); generic vuren-softwood values follow EN 13986 / NEN 1068 typical figures for spruce-pine softwood (vuren) at C24 grade.

name: Fermacell gypsum-fibre board (12 mm)
solid_material.description: Knauf Fermacell gypsum-fibre board, used as interior cladding on external walls. Datasheet thermal-conductivity figure for the 12 mm Fermacell sheet is ~0.32 W/(m·K); density ~1180 kg/m³.

name: Spaanplaat PRIME (11 mm)
solid_material.description: Interior chipboard cladding (binnenbekleding) on the warm side of the roof and ceiling assemblies. PRIME is the SKH-/FSC-certified chipboard grade specified for the rieten-dak and PV-dak interior face.

name: Spaanplaat V313 (11 mm)
solid_material.description: Water-resistant chipboard (V313 grade) used as the stability sheathing (stabiliteitsplaat) on the warm side of the external wall and as the sole sheathing on internal stability walls.

name: OSB3 sheathing board
solid_material.description: OSB3 grade oriented-strand board: load-bearing, moisture-resistant. Used at 15 mm as the rieten-dak sub-deck (under the reed) and at 18 mm with veer-en-groef as the upper-floor decks. Same material at both thicknesses; the layer's `thickness` field carries the size.

name: Vuren C24 structural softwood
solid_material.description: Structural-grade vuren (spruce-pine softwood), strength class C24. Used as roof rafters (sporen 36x245 mm h.o.h. 600 mm), wall studs (stijlen 36x270 mm h.o.h. 600 mm) and floor joists (balklaag 38x285/270 mm h.o.h. 400 mm). FSC-mix certified, SKH-COC-000076.

name: Vuren softwood, gewolmaniseerd (CCA-treated)
solid_material.description: Wolmanit-treated softwood for nailing battens (spijkerregels 38x42 mm h.o.h. 600 mm) behind the outer cladding and for tengels (counter-battens 21x48 mm) under the PV decking. Thermal properties match plain vuren; the treatment is for moisture/biological resistance only.

name: Vuren rough-sawn decking (22 mm)
solid_material.description: Ruwe vuren delen 22x100 mm: rough-sawn softwood boards forming the outer-most structural deck of the PV-paneled roof sections, on top of the tengels.

name: Knauf Naturoll 032 (mineral wool, λ=0.032)
solid_material.description: Knauf Insulation Naturoll 032 glass-mineral-wool roll, declared thermal conductivity λ_D = 0.032 W/(m·K). Used as the wall insulation (120 mm + 140 mm = 260 mm total in the 270 mm stud cavity between 36x270 mm vuren stijlen) and as the inner half of the roof insulation (120 mm of the 240 mm 2x120 mm 032+035 stack between 36x245 mm vuren C24 sporen).

name: Knauf Naturoll 035 (mineral wool, λ=0.035)
solid_material.description: Knauf Insulation Naturoll 035 glass-mineral-wool roll, declared thermal conductivity λ_D = 0.035 W/(m·K). Used as the outer half of the roof insulation (120 mm of the 240 mm 2x120 mm stack: 032 inside, 035 outside, per the spec's `032+035` notation).

name: PE foil vapour barrier (0.15 mm)
solid_material.description: Polyethylene vapour-control foil, dampremmende laag, 0.15 mm. Air-tight and vapour-resistant; thermal contribution is negligible at this thickness but the layer is retained for audit-trail completeness against the architectural spec.

name: Morgo-Vent 120 vapour-permeable breather membrane
solid_material.description: Morgo-Vent 120: three-layer polypropylene spunbond-meltblown breather membrane on the cold side of the wall insulation. Thermally negligible; declared here for audit-trail completeness.

name: Morgo Top Solar PV underlayment membrane
solid_material.description: Morgo Top Solar: waterproof, vapour-permeable underlayment specified for the PV-paneled roof sections, between the rafter cavity and the tengels-plus-decking on the cold side. Thermally negligible.

name: Reed thatch (rieten dak)
solid_material.description: Dutch-style reed thatch on the rieten-dak sections. Thatch is laid on top of the 15 mm OSB3 sub-deck. Typical Dutch thatch thickness ~30 cm; thermal conductivity typical for compressed reed thatch ≈0.09 W/(m·K).

name: Outer wall cladding (DCV, supplier-delivered)
solid_material.description: Buitenbekleding 'buiten levering DCV': the outer wall cladding is delivered separately by DCV and is not specified in the architectural drawing extract reviewed. Treated here as a generic ~22 mm timber cladding for thickness / heat-capacity bookkeeping; the actual product (timber boarding, fibre cement, composite, etc.) should be confirmed with the owner-occupier and updated in this material entry.

name: Cement screed with embedded floor heating
solid_material.description: Cement-based screed carrying the vloerverwarming pipework. Confirmed by the spec ('Verwarming; vloerverwarming'); thickness here (65 mm) is a typical value, not from the architectural drawing extract.

name: HR++ double glazing pane
solid_material.description: Low-e coated float glass, HR++ rated. Per spec: U=1.1 W/(m²·K), ZTA (g) = 0.60.

name: Ventilated air cavity (rainscreen / counter-batten zone)
gas.description: Ventilated air cavity behind the outer cladding (38x42 mm spijkerregels) and under the PV decking (21x48 mm tengels). Per ISO 6946 a strongly-ventilated cavity contributes only the surface-resistance equivalent (Rse ≈ 0.04 m²K/W) and no thermal mass.

name: Insulated timber door panel
solid_material.description: Insulated timber door leaf, used in both front and back doors. The U-value (1.43 W/m²K voordeur, 1.64 W/m²K achterdeur) is set on the LayeredConstruction itself (frame-included); the layer is a thickness placeholder so the per-surface Thickness attribute computes.

name: Kanaalplaatvloer (prestressed hollow-core concrete slab, 260 mm)
solid_material.description: Prefab prestressed kanaalplaatvloer, spanning 8 m (full house width). Drawn at 0.260 m in the CAD detail. Effective thermal conductivity and density account for the longitudinal hollow channels (void fraction typically ~40%). λ=1.2 W/(m·K) and ρ=1200 kg/m³ are representative values for hollow-core slabs; solid-concrete values (λ=1.8, ρ=2400) would overestimate both conductance and thermal mass.

name: EPS floor insulation below kanaalplaatvloer (192 mm)
solid_material.description: Insulation layer below the kanaalplaatvloer slab, 0.192 m per CAD drawing. Product not specified in the architectural drawing extract; EPS is the most common choice for under-slab insulation in Dutch begane-grondvloer applications.

name: Acoustic / decoupling separation layer (20 mm)
solid_material.description: Layer between the kanaalplaatvloer slab and the screed, drawn as a full-black 0.020 m band in the CAD floor detail. Full-black at 20 mm in Dutch structural drawings typically indicates a foam acoustic-insulation or decoupling board (ontkoppelingslaag) that prevents structure-borne sound from coupling into the screed. Exact product not specified; PE-foam or EPS-acoustic properties used.

name: Construction Library
features.description: Layered constructions authored from the architectural specification of the owner-occupier residence: HSB timber-frame envelope with two roof variants (rieten-dak Rc>6.0, PV-dak Rc<6.0), exterior wall Rc=5.0, kanaalplaatvloer begane-grondvloer (Rc≈6.1, see constr_ground_floor), HR++ glazing with U=1.1 / g=0.60, and timber doors with frame-included U-values. Layer order is inner-face first, outer-face last.

name: External wall (HSB timber frame, Rc=5.0)
layered_construction.description: HSB buitengevel per arch. spec ('BUITENGEVEL opbouw RC 5.0 m2.K/W'). Outer-cladding (DCV) is supplier-delivered and its product is unspecified in the spec extract: the cladding layer is a generic timber placeholder. The 36x270 mm vuren stud cavity holds 260 mm of Naturoll 032 (120+140 mm); a ventilated 42 mm cavity behind the cladding is captured as a Gas layer per ISO 6946.

layer.description: Binnenbekleding gipsvezelplaat 12 mm Fermacell
Dampremmende laag PE folie 0.15 mm
Stabiliteitsplaat 11 mm spaanplaat V313
Inner half of stud-cavity insulation: Naturoll 032, 120 mm of the 260 mm 120+140 mm stack between 36x270 mm vuren stijlen h.o.h. 600 mm
Outer half of stud-cavity insulation: Naturoll 032, remaining 140 mm of the 260 mm stack
Bovenbekleding Morgo-Vent 120 vapour-permeable PP spunbond breather (~0.5 mm)
Spijkerregels vuren gewolmaniseerd 38x42 mm h.o.h. 600 mm: ventilated rainscreen cavity behind outer cladding
Buitenbekleding 'buiten levering DCV' (product unspecified in arch. drawing extract; placeholder)

name: Ground floor (kanaalplaatvloer, Rc≈6.1)
layered_construction.description: Begane grondvloer confirmed from CAD drawing as a prestressed kanaalplaatvloer spanning 8 m. Build-up from bottom (ground) to top (interior): 192 mm insulation below slab | 260 mm kanaalplaatvloer | 20 mm acoustic/decoupling layer (full-black in drawing) | 70 mm screed with embedded vloerverwarming. Computed Rc: 0.192/0.036 + 0.260/1.2 + 0.020/0.040 + 0.070/1.4 = 5.33 + 0.22 + 0.50 + 0.05 = 6.10 m²K/W, which exceeds the 'Begane grondvloer Rc=5.0 m2.K/W' Bouwbesluit minimum as expected for a nul-op-de-meter dwelling. The EPS insulation product and the exact 20 mm decoupling material are unconfirmed; see mapping_building.md § 16.

layer.description: Dekvloer / screed 70 mm with embedded floor heating (vloerverwarming)
Ontkoppelingslaag / acoustic decoupling board 20 mm (full-black layer in CAD drawing; exact product unconfirmed)
Kanaalplaatvloer 260 mm — prestressed hollow-core concrete slab, 8 m span
Isolatie 192 mm onder kanaalplaatvloer (product unconfirmed; EPS assumed)

name: Reed roof (sporendak tpv riet, Rc>6.0)
layered_construction.description: Sporendaken tpv riet per arch. spec ('SPORENDAKEN TPV RIET opbouw RC >6.0 m2.K/W'). Sloped HSB rafter roof: 36x245 mm vuren C24 sporen h.o.h. 600 mm, 240 mm of Naturoll 032+035 (120 mm 032 inside, 120 mm 035 outside) between rafters, 15 mm OSB3 sub-deck, ~300 mm reed thatch as the outer covering. The reed thatch layer pushes the assembly Rc above 6.0 m²K/W per the spec.

layer.description: Binnenbekleding 11 mm spaanplaat PRIME
Dampremmende laag PE folie 0.15 mm
Inner half of rafter-cavity insulation: Naturoll 032, 120 mm of 240 mm 2x120 mm stack between 36x245 mm vuren C24 sporen h.o.h. 600 mm
Outer half of rafter-cavity insulation: Naturoll 035, 120 mm of 240 mm 2x120 mm stack
Bovenbekleding 15 mm OSB3 sub-deck
Reed thatch exterior, ~300 mm typical Dutch rieten-dak depth

name: PV-paneled roof (sporendak tpv PV-panelen, Rc<6.0)
layered_construction.description: Sporendaken tpv PV-panelen per arch. spec ('SPORENDAKEN TPV PV-PANELEN opbouw RC <6.0 m2.K/W'). Identical rafter-cavity insulation as the reed-roof variant (240 mm Naturoll 032+035) but the cold-side build-up is a PV decking instead of reed thatch: Morgo Top Solar membrane, 21x48 mm tengels (counter-battens forming a ventilated cavity), 22x100 mm ruwe vuren delen as the PV-mount deck. The PV panels themselves are modelled separately as nrg3:PhotovoltaicCollector (pv_panel_1) and are not part of this construction. Mapped to RoofSurface_06 / RoofSurface_07 via construction_mapping.by_id.

layer.description: Binnenbekleding 11 mm spaanplaat PRIME
Dampremmende laag PE folie 0.15 mm
Inner half of rafter-cavity insulation: Naturoll 032, 120 mm of 240 mm 2x120 mm stack between 36x245 mm vuren C24 sporen h.o.h. 600 mm
Outer half of rafter-cavity insulation: Naturoll 035, 120 mm
Bovenbekleding Morgo Top Solar PV underlayment membrane (~0.5 mm)
Tengels vuren 21x48 mm counter-battens: ventilated cavity under PV deck
Ruwe vuren delen 22x100 mm decking on which PV panels are mounted

name: Uninsulated reed sub-roof (sporendak tpv riet, ongeisoleerd)
layered_construction.description: Sporendaken tpv riet ongeisoleerd per arch. spec ('SPORENDAKEN TPV RIET opbouw (ongeisoleerd)'): rafters 36x196 mm vuren C24 h.o.h. 600 mm and 15 mm OSB3 sub-deck, with reed thatch on top. No insulation, no inner cladding, no vapour barrier. Library entry only: this build-up most likely covers an unheated overhang or a thatched canopy; no roof surface in the current LOD3 geometry is mapped to it. See mapping_building.md § 16 (canonical-input gap log) for the unresolved geometric extent.

layer.description: Sporen vuren C24 36x196 mm h.o.h. 600 mm: rafter cavity is open (no insulation per spec); modelled as a thin-air structural-cavity placeholder
Bovenbekleding 15 mm OSB3 sub-deck
Reed thatch exterior, ~300 mm

name: First-floor deck (vloerelement 1e verdieping)
layered_construction.description: Vloerelementen 1e verdieping per arch. spec: 38x285 mm vuren C24 balklaag h.o.h. 400 mm with 18 mm OSB3 veer-en-groef bovenplaat. No ceiling finish or acoustic underlay specified; library entry only - no InteriorFloorSurface in the current LOD3 envelope geometry. Documented for completeness so a future LOD4 zoning pass can reuse the build-up.

layer.description: Joist-cavity placeholder: 38x285 mm vuren C24 balklaag h.o.h. 400 mm; modelled as ventilated-air cavity since no insulation or ceiling layer is specified
Bovenplaat 18 mm OSB3 met veer en groef

name: Second-floor deck (vloerelement 2e verdieping)
layered_construction.description: Vloerelementen 2e verdieping per arch. spec: 38x270 mm vuren C24 balklaag h.o.h. 400 mm with 18 mm OSB3 veer-en-groef bovenplaat. Library entry only - same status as constr_first_floor.

layer.description: Joist-cavity placeholder: 38x270 mm vuren C24 balklaag h.o.h. 400 mm
Bovenplaat 18 mm OSB3 met veer en groef

name: Stability internal wall (stabiliteitsbinnenwand)
layered_construction.description: Stabiliteitsbinnenwanden per arch. spec: 11 mm spaanplaat V313 stability sheathing on one side of 38x89 mm vuren stijlen h.o.h. 600 mm. The opposite face is unsheathed in the spec extract; modelled as ventilated-air cavity since the actual finish (gypsum, fermacell, exposed?) is not stated. Library entry only - no InteriorWallSurface in the current LOD3 envelope geometry.

layer.description: Stabiliteitsplaat 11 mm spaanplaat V313
Open stud cavity 38x89 mm vuren stijlen h.o.h. 600 mm (no insulation per spec)

name: Internal partition wall (binnenwand)
layered_construction.description: Binnenwanden per arch. spec: 38x89 mm vuren stijlen h.o.h. 600 mm (or 400 mm in wet rooms). No sheathing, insulation, or finish materials are stated in the drawing extract. Library entry only - no InteriorWallSurface in the current LOD3 envelope geometry.

layer.description: Open stud cavity 38x89 mm vuren stijlen h.o.h. 600 mm (no finish specified)

name: Window HR++ (U=1.1, g=0.60)
layered_construction.description: HR++ double glazing per arch. spec ('Beglazing: HR++, U=1.1 W/m2.K, ZTA 0,60'): 4 mm float / 16 mm argon / 4 mm low-e float. The frame-included U is variable (spec 'Kozijn incl. glas U=variabel min. 1,65 W/m2'); the value here (1.1) is the centre-of-glass U and the glazing_ratio captures the frame fraction.

layer.description: Inner pane (low-e coated)
Outer pane

name: Front door (U=1.43 incl frame)
layered_construction.description: Insulated timber front door per arch. spec ('Voordeuren: U=1,43 W/m2.k (incl kozijn)'). The U-value includes the frame. Build-up of the door leaf is not detailed in the spec extract; the layer is a 54 mm timber-leaf placeholder so the per-surface Thickness attribute computes.

name: Back door (U=1.64 incl frame)
layered_construction.description: Insulated timber back door per arch. spec ('Achterdeuren: U=1,64 W/m2.k (incl kozijn)'). The U-value includes the frame. Build-up of the door leaf is not detailed in the spec extract; the layer is a 48 mm timber-leaf placeholder.

name: Schedule Library
features.description: Heating and cooling setpoint schedules for the thermal zone parts. Per the Energy ADE 3.0 UML the schedule definitions are held here (InLine) while each ZonePart references them by XLink (ByReference); the XSD cannot enforce this, so it is a modelling convention.
